gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subjects with suspected infiltrating glioma on pre-operative brain imaging scans including non-enhancing MRI tumor components in non-eloquent regions that are within the planned surgical resection volume

candidate_evidence.quote: ExAblate 4000 - Type 2 (other names: ExAblate BBBD): Using ExAblate Model 4000 Type-2 to temporarily disrupt the blood brain barrier in non-enhancing suspected infiltrating glioma undergoing resection

role_evidence.quote: patients with a history of drug allergies, asthma or hay fever, and multiple allergies where the benefit/risk of administering Definity® is considered unfavorable by the study physicians in relation to the product labeling for Definity

agents.drug_class_hint: ultrasound contrast microbubbles used with focused ultrasound for BBB disruption

coder_notes: Device-only feasibility study of focused-ultrasound BBB disruption in suspected infiltrating glioma; glioblastoma appears only in keywords, so not named per C7. Phase NA. Definity (perflutren) microbubbles are not a registered intervention but the exclusion criteria imply they are administered to every patient for the BBBD procedure; listed as delivery_enabling_agent although no therapeutic drug is delivered. Gadolinium used only for MRI assessment of BBB opening, not listed (R9).
